source.target: x86-64 Linux SysV, direct CLIF object calls

new_host_observation.note: PC offsets happen to be equal in these exact eight cases; no universal equal-offset requirement is asserted

independent_archive_recheck.method: Downloaded original ZIP, verified GitHub-published SHA-256, independently decoded all archived x86 object disassemblies using system objdump, checked all 16 .o hashes against three receipts, independently recomputed instruction-byte counts, instruction counts and unsigned-div counts, checked all 18 recorded fault rows, then relinked the exact 16 .o artifacts and reran the recorded fault-PC C oracle with separately installed GCC 14.2.0 on a second x86-64 Linux container.
independent_archive_recheck.caution: Fresh host reexecution reused the original generated C host oracle; the independent archive rechecker and objdump cost parser were implemented separately. This is additional finite native execution, not an independent formal proof.

candidate.origin: human-authored bounded two-form adjacent udiv.i64 + urem.i64 to dual-result udivrem prototype; not ZenoFCIS-synthesized
candidate.semantic_domain: exact same SSA operands, adjacent same-block unsigned i64 udiv then urem; original udiv traps first on divisor zero
candidate.cost_measure: decoded x86-64 per-function instruction bytes/instructions/divisions, never CLIF cost or whole-AOT size
candidate.status: static saving only, no proven representative throughput benefit

limitations: Equal host POSIX si_code and mapped fault RIP do not establish Wasmtime trap tables, guest-visible trap code, catchability, source-map metadata or source locations.
Identical native fault offsets in observed fixtures are not guaranteed after layout or target changes.
No machine-ISA-wide, compiler-pass, SSA dominance, register-liveness, trap metadata, flags, poison/UB, register-allocation or cross-target proof.
No representative runtime profitability, whole-module/AOT reduction or upstream submission.
Do not claim a newly synthesized result; a human-authored compiler prototype remains under qualification.
repo_changes: Two experimental-branch commits plus this persistent evidence record; no ZenoFCIS main/release branch or Bytecode Alliance upstream modification; existing research PR #175 remains draft.
